title: The Acropolis, Then and Now
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mediterranean Travels
description: Hover over and click two aerial views of the Acropolis, about 406 BCE and today, to compare five monuments and what has been lost, rebuilt, or removed on purpose, then test yourself in Quiz mode.

educational.topic: The Athenian Acropolis, then and now
learningObjectives: The learner will compare the Acropolis of about 406 BCE with the rock a visitor climbs today, and for each of five monuments name what has been lost, rebuilt, replaced, or removed on purpose.
prerequisites: Chapter 15: the Acropolis and the Parthenon

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Side-by-side comparison followed by retrieval practice
keyQuestions: What was lost, rebuilt, replaced, or removed on purpose?
What did the restorers choose to show?
commonMisconceptions: The Parthenon was always a ruin.
All the sculpture was white marble.
assessmentOpportunities: Quiz mode: click the zone that matches each idea

controls.name: Explore
controls.description: Default mode: hover a zone for a tooltip, click it for the infobox.

controls.name: Quiz Mode
controls.description: Hides the name pills and asks 10 questions answered by clicking a zone.
